review_reference: Owner decisions of 11 Nov 2026 for open sign-up on outreach. (final): (1) "Q38 no check" (2026-11-11 ~10:05 UTC): there is no Health ID check before an organiser's campaigns go Active; a new organiser may set a campaign Active at once. Support can still suspend a group, which stops everything; the name blocklist stays; registrants are shown "Unverified organiser" for every outreach group. (2) No per-organiser limits (anti-bot protection and the invitation pending cap stay). (3) Registrations never linked to a Health ID are kept 1 year, then redacted. (4) Joint-controller terms and DPIA approved, terms version 2026-11-01. (5) An existing staff login may start an outreach group with the same login. (6) Free. Written as 0125 and 0126; numbered 0114 and 0115, then 0115 and 0116 on 2026-11-11 in the release plan (production ends at 0111, campaign admins (#222, signed); 0112 (#226), 0113 (#229) and 0114 (#223, the sign-up fields) release before them). Built on #222's 0111, which was declared and signed in its own PR and is now merged. reviewed_by is empty until the owner signs this declaration.
evidence: Migrations 0115_outreach_organisers.sql and 0116_outreach_retention.sql and services/ehr-api/database/runtime-grants.sql (the files this PR changes under services/ehr-api/database/, tests excluded); unsigned until the owner signs (reviewed_by is empty). 0115 WHAT IT DOES: two roles, outreach_organiser (outreach.campaign.read/write, outreach.registration.read/write) and outreach_volunteer (outreach.campaign.read, outreach.registration.read/write); identity.outreach_organisations (one row per outreach group: its own organization and facility, lifecycle verified; status active|suspended, no review columns), identity.outreach_organiser_signups and identity.outreach_invitations (forced RLS, no runtime privilege); public sign-up commands for the Identity runtime (system:auth: start, resend code, verify email, activate; the control outreach_organiser_signup_enabled, seeded OFF, gates them; a group name suggesting a hospital, a health agency or a government body is refused at sign-up and activation (identity.outreach_group_name_allowed: the name is reduced with Unicode NFKD and its accents dropped, anything left that is not a Latin letter, digit, space or . , ' ’ & ( ) - / refuses it, so look-alike letters from other scripts and invisible characters cannot hide a word; single letters are joined so N.C.D.C reads as ncdc; words and phrases such as hospital, hosp, ministry, government, federal, agency, commission, world health, disease control, primary health care, health care board, medical centre, health service, red cross, UNICEF, NCDC, NPHCDA, NHIS, NHIA, LUTH, FMC, MSF in any case; WHO only as the acronym; Identity applies the same rule); an email that already has a login is answered email_registered; the public application quota per network, at most 5 sign-ups per network a day and at most 3 sign-ups (code emails) per email a day ('email_rate_limited'); a phone that is a suspended group's contact phone is answered 'suspended' and its earlier sign-up cannot be activated; resend answers the sign-up's email with 'sent' (Identity has no read of the sign-up table)); identity.activate_outreach_organiser_for_account (a signed-in staff login starts its own group: a second membership as outreach_organiser at the new group, hospital roles untouched; 'suspended' when the login organised a suspended group or the phone is a suspended group's contact phone, so a suspension is not undone by starting again); a login with no staff record and no platform role (a patient's Health ID login) gets the answer 'patient_login' from the public sign-up, this command and every invitation path; the fence trigger account_roles_outreach_fence on auth.account_roles (only the two outreach roles at an outreach group, those roles nowhere else, nothing at a suspended group; revocations pass); outreach invitations (only an organiser invites, always outreach_volunteer; abuse guards, because the email names the group: at most 50 pending and 30 made per group in 24 hours, cancelled ones included ('too_many_today'), sending paused after 10 undeliverable emails in 24 hours ('sending_paused'), and an address gets at most 3 outreach invitation emails in 24 hours from all groups (past that the invitation is made with dispatch false and is not emailed); identity.record_outreach_invitation_delivery records the email service's answer; hospital staff invitations untouched); the trigger outreach_organiser_tenant_rules on outreach.registration_cases, campaigns, campaign_members and patient_mappings, acting only at an outreach group's facility (a registration needs a campaign, notes at most 280 characters, nothing changes while suspended, no Health ID link; a campaign may go Active at once: no check, per Q38); outreach.registration_consents (one immutable consent row per registration, guardian name required under 18; a deferred constraint trigger refuses a group's registration without one; a restrictive read policy shows a consent row only when its registration is visible to the caller); the permissive policy outreach_campaigns_member_lock so a campaign's own member who may register can lock it FOR SHARE (WITH CHECK false); outreach.organiser_status() for outreach-api ('active', 'suspended', or null when the session facility is not an outreach group: the "Unverified organiser" label is shown whenever it is not null); support commands (list organisers by 'active', 'suspended' or 'all'; suspend, which revokes the group's roles and pending invitations; close a group's campaign; appoint a campaign admin; platform.admin.access with platform.facility.read, or .manage and .unlock to change; audited as platform actions). There is no review command. Support's campaign rescue runs inside a 'support run' (outreach.privileged_runs, a row for the current transaction that only these commands write); 0115 adds support policies on outreach.campaigns and outreach.campaign_members, lets 0111's two restrictive member policies pass inside a support run (each dropped and created again with 0111's name, RESTRICTIVE kind, command and roles, its expression gaining only the support-run branch), and replaces outreach.validate_campaign_write() (0111's body, md5 ca793433b75b2be758cc70fb7a4779cc, kept whole after a first branch: inside a support run only the status may change, to closed). REPLACES platform.control_enabled (0086's body, md5 ed17b9d8097417363c0a6343e52aa47f, plus the new key; new md5 1d24fbded6edff32d934d319b0135fb2) and the control key CHECK (0086's ten keys plus the new one). 0116 WHAT IT DOES: outreach.campaigns.closed_at (nullable, metadata-only ADD COLUMN), stamped by a trigger, never written by a caller; outreach.registration_retain_until = closed_at + 365 days (or last change + 365 days for a campaign closed before 0116), or starts_at + 365 days while not closed; outreach.registration_redactions; identity.sweep_expired_outreach_registrations(limit) (Identity runtime, system:auth), identity.admin_redact_outreach_registration(case, reason) (support, on request) and identity.admin_find_outreach_registrations(organization, temporary ID, phone) (support's search before that deletion: exactly one of a temporary ID (tmp_ and a UUID) or a phone number of 7 or more digits, +234 and a leading 0 compared alike by outreach.registration_phone_key; answers only case ID, group name, campaign name, temporary ID, when and whether already deleted, at most 20 rows, read inside a retention run; audited with the group, which of the two was given and the count, never the value; 22023 OUTREACH_REGISTRATION_LOOKUP_INVALID otherwise): an outreach group's unlinked registration is redacted (full_name '[redacted]', phone and notes null, consent guardian '[redacted]', idempotency request hash zeroed; sex, age, campaign, dates kept) inside a 'retention run'; the sweeper also deletes sign-ups never activated after 30 days and outreach invitations never accepted 30 days after they expired or were cancelled (the audit row records only counts). None is executable by the Outreach runtime. REPLACES outreach.validate_registration_case_write() (0024, md5 a12d2b2573c5c7e52bcb5a8cdb1ec190; every rule kept, plus the redaction transition inside a retention run), outreach.validate_registration_campaign_write() (0110, md5 69469315f04554d2639dfa9f83591d4d; unchanged except that a redaction needs no membership; new md5 8812e9009aed4841b99fae04d5525d7b) and the no-mutation trigger on outreach.command_idempotency (now refuses everything but the redaction of request_sha256); adds retention policies and lets 0045's two restrictive registration policies pass inside a retention run (each dropped and created again with 0045's name, RESTRICTIVE kind, command and roles, its expressions gaining only the retention-run branch). runtime-grants.sql gains 0115's and 0116's grants (as the migrations grant them). BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: nothing changes for hospitals, laboratories, pharmacies or the demo tenant (every new rule acts only at an outreach group's facility, and none exists until the control is switched on or the signed-in command runs); today's identity-api and outreach-api images work unchanged (no column they read changes; campaigns gains a nullable column). The control ships OFF. RELEASE ORDER: owner signs; 0111 (signed, #222) is live; 0112 (#226), 0113 (#229) and 0114 (#223, the sign-up fields) release first; then 0115 and 0116 (one release, with #233's services); release outreach-api and identity-api (PR-3, PR-4); website; switch the control on. PRECONDITIONS of 0115 (catalog reads only; 55000 or 42501, nothing applied): 0001-0111 applied (0111's outreach.campaign_staff(uuid) is the marker; 0115 uses nothing 0112-0114 add and validate_campaign_write has 0111's body), not applied yet, control_enabled and the key CHECK as 0086 left them, 0111's two restrictive member policies, the applier may SET ROLE to the table owners. RE-PROVED on 2026-11-11 after the review fixes (resend answers the email; a suspended organiser or a suspended group's phone cannot start again; invitation and sign-up email caps and the delivery record; the stricter name rule; invitations deleted by the retention sweep), on a new throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (UTF8, deleted afterwards): the same fresh install, all 86 SQL suites pass, db:plan 0 pending. New suites: services/ehr-api/test/database/outreach-organiser-signup.integration.sql (114 cases, among them the resend answering the email, the name bypasses (World Health Organization, Ncdc, N.C.D.C, Teaching Hosp, a Cyrillic letter, wide letters, an invisible space and more), 3 sign-ups per email, 30 invitations a day, 3 invitation emails per address, the pause after 10 undeliverable emails, and a suspended organiser and a suspended group's phone refused; a new group's admin opens a campaign at once and may create one already Active, no review command or column exists, support's list has no 'pending' state) and outreach-retention.integration.sql (26 cases, among them invitations never accepted deleted 30 days after they ended), run as hid_identity_api_runtime and hid_outreach_api_runtime under the sessions those services set, and the fence cases as the owner of auth.account_roles. Changed suites: provider-self-service-control and provider-self-service-rollback (eleven control keys), order-routes-cannot-complete (control_enabled's new md5), outreach-campaign-registration (0116's trigger md5; the lent owner also needs EXECUTE on outreach.privileged_run_active and registration_campaign_member), runtime-command-privileges (Case 4 accepts outreach_volunteer through the member-lock policy). scripts/verify-migration-ledger.mjs passes; the release ledger check reports a missing migration prefix until 0112 to 0114 land, as expected. RE-PROVED on 2026-11-11 after renumbering to 0115 and 0116, adding identity.admin_find_outreach_registrations and merging staging (7adf322b) and the services (#233), on throwaway local PostgreSQL 16 clusters (deleted afterwards; fictional data only): the acceptance runner's fresh install through PostgreSQL TLS, with all 86 SQL suites passing, among them outreach-organiser-signup (114 cases), outreach-retention (40, of which 14 cover the search) and 0110's outreach-campaign-registration (17, pinning the renumbered trigger body md5 8812e9009aed4841b99fae04d5525d7b); the five outreach suites on a database whose migrator is NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS; the same five with 0112 (#226), 0113 (#229) and 0114 (#223) applied first, as the release plan orders them; and services/ehr-api/scripts/test-staging-schema-upgrade.mjs (baseline 0001-0111 with staging's runtime-grants.sql, declared exactly 0115 and 0116, a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator): passed. identity-api (2003 tests), outreach-api (77), notification-api (356) and ehr-api (825) pass, with clean typechecks.
